title: SCRIPE Authorization & Entitlements Architecture Walkthrough
intro: Trace how requests, dotted resource keys, multi-role FLS merges, and post-commit cache evictions collaborate across Next.js 16 and .NET 10 without cross-module coupling or privilege leakage.
outro: Every tenant request is gated by cold-warmed context, live IFeatureChecker evaluation, Priority-0 FLS intersection, and export redaction.

points.title: Route Guard & Context Switch
points.text: The Next.js 16 MVVM shell validates route permissions and platform vs tenant workspace boundaries before attaching the active JWT and X-Tenant-Context header.
points.caption: Next.js 16 ingress enters ASP.NET Core

points.title: Pre-Authz Context & Cold Warm
points.text: TenantContextMiddleware runs before RequireMfaEnrollmentMiddleware and UseAuthorization, skipping unauthenticated requests (401) and cold-warming AdminPermissionCache before resolving bidirectional MembershipMode.
points.caption: Middleware establishes authoritative tenant context

points.title: Catalog Metadata + Live Feature Check
points.text: PermissionAuthorizationHandler resolves RequiredAnyFeatures (OR semantics) and IsGloballyAvailable from the 490-permission FrozenDictionary, then calls fail-closed IFeatureChecker on live Entitlements.
points.caption: PBAC verifies catalog + live feature flag simultaneously

points.title: Entitlements Evaluation
points.text: Live feature checks query Entitlements overrides, base edition, and non-marketing FeaturePackExpansions before admitting or refusing with 403.
points.caption: Fail-closed Entitlements gate verifies tenant eligibility

points.title: Entitled Role Selection (Priority 0 Asc)
points.text: AdminSecurityService loads active Roles ordered by Priority ascending (0 = highest), filtering out permissions disabled by live tenant features.
points.caption: Roles & UserGroups feed FLS merge

points.title: Dotted Resource Preservation
points.text: FieldLevelSecurityMergeHelper intersects restrictions across read-capable roles, unions additive UserGroup restrictions on top, and relies on PermissionResourceNormalizer without truncating dotted keys like crm.opportunities.
points.caption: Intersection per role, union per UserGroup, dotted key kept intact

points.title: JSON, Write & File Export Parity
points.text: FieldProjectionMiddleware, FieldRestrictionEnforcementBehavior, and Export/DataTransfer guards enforce identical masked fields and record visibility across REST JSON, CSV/XLSX/PDF exports, and queued background jobs.
points.caption: REST responses and async exports share one FLS boundary

points.title: Tenant-Filtered Picker Alignment
points.text: Roles & Restrictions Studio fetches non-PlatformOnly catalog items filtered by live tenant features, hiding unavailable modules and platform-only host actions cleanly.
points.caption: UI pickers match backend assignable permissions 1:1

scenes.title: 3. Non-Destructive Entitlements Sync & Atomic Cache Eviction

points.title: Commit Transaction Before Event Dispatch
points.text: EffectiveFeatureMapBuilder persists subscription or TenantFeatureOverride updates to EntitlementsDbContext first, then emits SubscriptionChanged integration events after SaveChangesAsync succeeds.
points.caption: Zero pre-commit race condition on event handlers

points.title: Tenant Permission Pool Sync
points.text: AstraFlow dispatches the committed event to TenantPermissionManager, recomputing the tenant permission pool using catalog RequiredAnyFeatures and IsGloballyAvailable rules.
points.caption: Pool sync tracks enabled editions cleanly

points.title: Preserve Custom Roles & Stamp Cache
points.text: TenantPermissionManager updates TenantPermissions and T_SCRIPE_SA while leaving custom RolePermissions untouched in IdentityDbContext, then evicts AdminPermissionCache and bumps admin:principal:* stamps.
points.caption: Zero privilege hangover and zero custom-role loss
